Anna / team —

Thanks for the quick review and the specifics. Short answers below, plus an initial remediation plan we can commit to publicly for marketplace intake.

1) Token expiry medium finding
- Root cause: our token refresh logic did not account for a 3rd-party edge caching layer in a small percentage of long-lived sessions (repro steps in internal ticket #INF-4721).
- Remediation plan: update refresh logic and add guardrail to force token refresh at 22h for sessions > 20h; deploy canary to 2% traffic for verification and full rollout once metrics look good.
- Estimated timeline: engineering fix + canary verification — 7 business days from today (target: 2026-05-20); full rollout 3 business days after verification (target: 2026-05-25).

2) Dependency scanning low finding
- Already in backlog; scheduled for the next minor patch (target: 2026-05-18).

3) Full pen-test report
- We can share the full report under an NDA. If you confirm we’ll start the NDA process and route the report to security@polestar.com via our secure transfer.

4) DPA & signature
- Priya will send a clean DocuSign DPA by EOD today (11 May). The attached redline reflects minor language around data residency and subprocessor notifications — nothing material to block acceptance.

Proposed acceptance criteria for marketplace readiness (what we need from Polestar):
- Acceptance of redacted SOC2 auditor letter and pen-test exec summary (you confirmed SOC2 already).
- Acknowledgement of remediation timeline for medium findings (this email thread).
- Completed DPA signature via DocuSign.

We’ll also paste a short public-facing remediation note for the listing once the token expiry fix is in canary.

Attachment: DPA-Redline-Polestar-v3.docx (redline)

— Kimberly
